purpose: Attach every canonical Hero's explicit CastingLawTemplates_ID list to the frozen Casting Law material catalog, classify exact cost signatures for presentation, and precompute per-Hero level 1-5 / 6-10 / 1-10 material and gold totals without inferring Hero-template relations.

relationContract.hero: hero-name-master.records[].heroId -> ConfigDataHeroInfo.ID by explicit numeric equality
relationContract.templates: ConfigDataHeroInfo.CastingLawTemplates_ID[] preserved in source order; only positive integer IDs are admitted

costProfileRule: Classify only by the exact 10-level gold/count signature in the frozen material catalog. No template-ID range, name, icon, Hero identity, or equipment filename may determine the profile.
slotPresentationRule: Use template EquipmentType metadata when explicit (1=armor, 2=head, 3=accessory). Templates without EquipmentType are preserved as weapon slots in source order. This label is presentation only and does not create a new semantic relation.
normalizationRules: Require exactly one ConfigDataHeroInfo row for every canonical Hero ID.
Preserve CastingLawTemplates_ID source order and duplicate occurrences; do not deduplicate because separate slots may legitimately share a template.
Ignore only non-positive/non-integer placeholder values; never replace them by name, order, ID arithmetic, or historical output.
Resolve every admitted template ID exactly once in the frozen hero-casting-law-materials catalog.
Aggregate material counts by explicit Item ID and gold by exact frozen per-level costs.
Compute independent totals for level 1-5, level 6-10, and level 1-10.
Do not gate template availability on centralDiscipline.status or CastingLawSkill_ID.
Do not reopen Hero Stage 6 central-discipline skill semantics.

PASS: Generated Hero population exactly matches the canonical Hero master.
Every canonical Hero resolves to exactly one ConfigDataHeroInfo row.
Every positive CastingLawTemplates_ID entry resolves to the frozen Casting Law catalog.
Every referenced template matches exactly one of cost profiles A/B/C by full 10-level signature.
Per-Hero material and gold totals reproduce direct summation from frozen template levels.
No name JOIN, ID arithmetic, or central-discipline release proxy is used.
FAIL: Any Hero identity, source cardinality, template relation, cost-profile, material total, gold total, or frozen-source parity mismatch occurs.

completionRule: Run producer and independent validator against current canonical Hero master, pinned ConfigData source-pack, and frozen Casting Law catalog. Completion requires PASS/PASS, full canonical population, zero unresolved template refs, exact aggregate parity, and no unexpected repository mutation.
